description: 976 Hydrants (bornes d'incendie) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.observatoire-de-mayotte.fr. Distribution of accessible water points for SDIS firefighters. Hydrants are fire-fighting systems put in place by the municipalities. It is a groundwater system to supply fire vans to firefighters. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "976 Hydrants (fire markers)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Bornes, Mayotte, Secours, 976, SDIS Mayotte, Incendies. The listing shows 2019-02-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
